body:
claude-storymodel4s red-team pass on vision.md / mission.md (rev 2). Overall: accurate, well separated, and honest at the end; the risk is in the middle, where present tense implies implemented capability. Findings, with replacement language:

OVERCLAIMS OF CURRENT IMPLEMENTATION (mission.md)
1. Opening: 'turn text or transcripts into evidence-backed artifacts, then align recalled content to known or inferred narrative structure.' Today only the surface atlas, recall segmentation, alignment inference, and interview scoring are automatic; story models are hand-built fixtures and charts come from PENMAN/hand input. Suggest: 'The library provides portable Scala 3 types, laws, validators, and inference algorithms for these artifacts; automatic construction of story models from raw text is the M1–M5 programme and is not yet implemented.' Keep the honest closing paragraph but list what is missing concretely: provider adapters, orchestrator, cross-sentence identity resolution, relation extraction, hierarchy induction, calibration corpora.
2. 'Document semantics preserves mentions before resolving cross-sentence entity and event identity…' — the types and quotient exist; no resolver does. Change 'resolving' to 'so that a later resolver can…'.
3. Boundaries, interview paragraph: 'the system can characterize the episode implied by the interview…' — v0.1 induction is rule-based and uncalibrated. Use 'is designed to characterize'.
4. Commitment 9 'validate them with … held-out stories, and calibrated evaluations' — no gold corpus exists yet; fine under 'We will', but add 'no learned component ships before a leave-story-out harness exists' (this is a non-negotiable in the roadmap and missing here).

MISSING NON-NEGOTIABLES (mission.md, add as commitments)
5. Anti-circularity: 'record which feature spaces contributed to any inferred boundary or hierarchy, and never test a feature against structure it helped induce without ablation or an independent boundary set' (design record §116; implemented as the feature-use ledger).
6. Portability as a contract: 'no portable module may depend on a JVM-only API; regex lookaround, java.util.Locale, java.security and java.time are excluded' — we have already hit this three times today; it belongs in writing.
7. Failure representation: 'a build that cannot resolve a claim returns Unresolved or Alternatives; it never manufactures precision to complete' (stated in prose; make it a numbered commitment).

VISION/MISSION BLUR (vision.md)
8. Paragraph 4 ('The mature system will build these representations unattended…') is operational and duplicates mission §'How unattended, auditable builds work'. Compress to one sentence: 'Such a system must run unattended and remain auditable; how is the mission's concern.'
9. 'once read or viewed' — video/audio are explicitly deferred; keep 'viewed' only if you add 'eventually'.
10. The bullet list reads as a roadmap. Keep the first five bullets (they are forms of inquiry); move 'derive familiar measures…' and 'connect behavioural output to population…neural analyses' to mission or a 'what this enables' note, or reword as questions the science asks rather than features.

SMALL
11. mission 'exact UTF-16 spans' — say 'exact UTF-16 code-unit spans, never cutting a code point' (we just fixed the surrogate case).
12. mission commitment 2 'words to windows to narrative units and back again' — true now (SurfaceSequence, FeatureTarget supports, SpanSet); keep.
13. Consider one sentence on scale posture: 'sparse by construction; no dense event-pair or unit-node allocations in core paths'.

Nothing in either file contradicts AGENTS.md or the roadmap rev 2. With 1–3 and 5–7 applied I would sign off.
